messages:
incident-bot: 🚨 Canary alert: elevated 5xxs for /v1/generate (eu-west) after deploy at 1764999990. Error rate 7.2% (baseline 0.3%). Paging oncall.
Priya K.: taking this. can someone post the deploy id?
Mateo: deploy id d-2026-03-15-5427 (canary rollout to 10% eu-west). I see spikes in model-timeout and gateway 503s.
Chen: grabbing logs from canary pods now. `kubectl logs -n inference canary-d-5427-* --tail=200`
Alex: I'm seeing repeated KV cache eviction warnings in the runtime logs and a stack of timeouts to the quant-kernel. snippet:
```
2026-03-15T08:12:03Z runtime WARN KVCache: eviction pressure high, evicted=42
2026-03-15T08:12:04Z worker ERROR quant-kernel: batch_timeout exceeded after 2000ms
```
Priya K.: thanks. @deploy-bot can we pause canary / flip kill-switch for that fflag (ff:canary-5427-quant)?
deploy-bot: `/feature-flag flip ff:canary-5427-quant off --by=oncall --reason="canary 5xx spike"`
deploy-bot: ✅ Feature flag ff:canary-5427-quant set to OFF (rolled back traffic to prev variant). Event id ev-87654.
Maya (support): quick q — do we have customer-facing impact? any active sessions affected?
Mateo: some API clients in eu-west saw 503s for about ~4 minutes starting 08:11 UTC. Percent of requests in that window ~6% of global traffic. Could be few enterprise customers — checking logs by org.
Chen: org-id 993 and 1172 show increased error rates. linking tickets: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INF-3124
Alex: I suggest we abort the rollout and trigger full rollback to stable model-variant (mv-2b-stable). Priya, want to coordinate rollback?
Priya K.: agreed. initiating rollback now. command:
```
./deploy rollback --id d-2026-03-15-5427 --target mv-2b-stable --scope=eu-west --force
```
deploy-bot: rollback job started job-9091. Will stream status here.
incident-bot: ONCALL: if rollback fails, escalate to eng-runtime and eng-ml. Runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/canary-failure
Mateo: monitoring. current QPS eu-west down 12% as traffic shifts. error rate trending down to 0.6%.
Chen: I pulled heap snapshots from one canary pod; memory graph shows a ~2x bump in temporary KV allocations after deploy. suspect regression in KV caching heuristics in new runtime path.
Alex: filing a postmortem ticket and tagging eng-runtime. INF-3125 created.
Priya K.: rollback completed (deploy-bot job-9091 -> succeeded). confirmed stable traffic in eu-west. Latency and error rates back to baseline. marking incident as mitigated.
Maya (support): pulling affected customer list and drafting comms. ETA 30m for initial notice.
Mateo: leaving notes for next oncall: collect flamegraphs from runtime with --profile=alloc --sample=10s, hold onto canary artifacts for debugging (don't delete pods immediately).
Priya K.: handing off to Chen for root-cause follow-up. I'm off in 45m — @Chen please lead RC and post timeline in #postmortems.
Chen: will do. starting deeper diff between mv-2b-quant kernels and stable kernels; pinging eng-ml.
Alex: thumbs. please add any regression tests for KV heuristic and add a canary test that simulates high prefix reuse load.
Priya K.: final status: mitigated, rollback successful, customer impact limited but non-zero (orgs 993, 1172). follow-up: RC, regression tests, communications. arch/eng-runtime/eng-ml on the hook for fix. leaving thread.
deploy-bot: rollforward/rollback artifacts archived: s3://redwood-artifacts/jobs/job-9091/ (ttl 72h)
incident-bot: INCIDENT: closed -> mitigated at 1765000300. If anything new crops up reopen thread.
Maya (support): added a short blurb for customers to review: "We briefly experienced elevated error rates in eu-west due to a canary rollout. Traffic was rolled back and service is stable. We’re investigating root cause and will update."
